about: Real Formula 1 cars recorded by Edvvc at the Goodwood Festival of Speed hillclimb (2009 and 2010), Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 (own work). Each entry is cut from the original recording: from `start` to `end` seconds, with fades, normalised to `lufs`. `cue` is when the car launches, in seconds from the start of the cut.
author: Edvvc

start.use: Intro: revs held on the line while the five lights come on, the clutch drops as they go out (2.45 s)

launch.use: Race weekend, race stage: idle, revs and launch timed to the lights going out

idle.use: Team pages, flat out: the idling engine, pitched up and opened out with the speed

era-1950.use: History, 1950s: a 1954 Mercedes-Benz W196, driven by Stirling Moss

era-1988.file: McLaren-Honda MP4 4 (1988) driven by Bruno Senna.ogg
era-1988.use: History, 1988: the McLaren MP4/4 itself, driven by Bruno Senna

era-2004.use: History, V10 years: a 2005 Red Bull RB1 (Cosworth V10), driven by Mark Webber
